prompt: Photorealistic premium feather badminton shuttlecock in flight, transparent alpha background, macro product photography. Rounded cream cork nose leads toward lower right, flared ivory feather skirt trails upper left, muted deep-teal tape band, side three-quarter profile, connected feather stems and white threads, complete subject visible. Fine feather texture, soft upper-left daylight, no motion blur, text, logos, racket, person or painted wind trails.

animation.method: Compositor Web Animations for a sampled continuous parabolic trajectory and velocity-aligned rotation; CSS transform and opacity for airflow
animation.trajectory: Enter from outside lower left, rise to an apex, then descend to the lower right. Continuous quadratic height and constant horizontal velocity; loop resets outside the frame.
animation.positionFormula: u=1.2*t; x=-0.5+1.64*u; y=1.03-3*u+3*u^2, normalized to frame dimensions
animation.heading: Cork direction follows the instantaneous velocity, recomputed for the frame aspect ratio
animation.staticFallback: Small centred shuttle before playback, including reduced-motion mode
animation.airflowStyle: Long contrasting teal and white streamlines, 1.8–3.5px non-scaling strokes, broad soft white wakes, persistent flow plus moving streaks following shuttle heading. Flight fades outside the frame to conceal long-tail loop reset.

description: Generated decorative shuttlecock flight visual; airflow is an artistic representation, not a scientific simulation or recorded athlete footage.
